season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep. Web search (WTA Star Peak page, Mountaineers Oval/Star page, summitpost) gives early summer to early fall for the peak, with snow possible by mid-September. Logged ascents peak Jun-Oct.

otherTracksConsidered.why: No logged route; track is the Star Lake scramble line to the summit, with no sign of the Fish Creek Pass northwest ridge.
Multi-peak day (Star, Grey, Courtney, Buttermilk Ridge); report says Star was climbed by the talus bowl and trail to the ridge. Link-up.
Logged N Bowl to SW Ridge; standard scramble line. Also June 7 is off season for the rock ridge.

notes: The NW ridge is a technical line from Fish Creek Pass; every harvested track is the Star Lake / southwest ridge scramble (already held as the Standard Scramble). No track qualifies.
